messages:
marta: ran the field-cache surge simulator overnight against the canary build (kernel switch + batcher tweak). numbers look... odd.
kenji: link to sim run? curious about hit-rate curves
marta: https://internal.rw/sim/381234 - summary: overall HV hit-rate went from 82% -> 64% at 10k qps, but median latency unchanged. logs attached.
samir: did kernel switch land in the canary? could be kv eviction differences
marta: yes, kernel-v2 landed. suspect kv key normalization changed resulting in small prefix mismatches. here's the trimmed log:
```json
{"req_id":"r-9f1","prefix_key":"user:123:ctx_v1","kv_hit":false}
{"req_id":"r-9f2","prefix_key":"user:123:ctx-v1","kv_hit":true}
```
seems like hyphen vs underscore normalization introduced
elaine: ugh. that would fragment the cache. were warmers using canonicalization?
marta: our deploy-time warmers generate prefixes from trace sampling with old normalizer. the new kernel normalizes at runtime. result: warmers primed different keys.
samir: can we normalize warmers post-deploy? quick patch: run a short transform job to rewrite seed keys using kernel-v2 normalizer
kenji: also saw batching heuristic change: we pack by token-length buckets -> changed distribution. could change KV TTL exposure because batch ordering affects eviction windows
marta: good point. simulator run toggled batcher=true and kernel=v2 together. need isolated runs. plan:
 - run kernel-v2 only (no batcher tweak)
 - run batcher tweak only
 - run both (already did)
 - add canonicalizer to warmers job
elaine: low-effort mitigation: add a fallback in runtime that treats legacy variants as equivalent for first 30s after deploy :thinking_face:
marta: noted. i'm going to schedule a scheduled preheat job that runs immediately post-deploy and 10/30/60 minutes after. will also add key rewrite step. i'll open an RFC.
deploy-bot: draft RFC created: https://internal.rw/rfc/9123 - "field-cache preheat: post-deploy canonicalization"
kenji: thanks. can you also attach perf profile? curious if KV miss handling increased CPU due to recompute
marta: attaching heap/cpu traces to RFC. short-term run: revert kernel-v2 on the canary and re-run sim so we can get clean delta
samir: I'll setup the isolated runs and report back by EOD. if hit-rate drop is >10% we roll kernel revert rollout
marta: cool, thx all :thumbsup:
